headline: nanoscribe/native/tokenize.py hard-truncated every input to 64 characters and decoded newlines to '?'. Span-port prompts are ~530 characters, so the model saw ~12% of its input and the gold value was frequently outside its view — the task was impossible by construction.

defects.impact: Prompts average 530 chars (max 576); 128/128 eval and 96/96 train prompts exceed 64. The model received 12.1% of each prompt, cut off mid-word. Every call site already applied `[: cfg.max_seq]` with max_seq=512, so the 64-char cap defeated the callers' own intent and used 12.5% of the configured context.

worked_example.model_saw: Transcript:?clinician: What symptoms are you having??patient: I

defects.fix: truncation is now the caller's decision (max_len param, default None)

defects.impact: '\n', '\t', '\r' have no preimage in printable ASCII and decoded to '?'. Turn separators were corrupted in 100% of corpus sources (224/224 lossy), destroying speaker/turn structure.
defects.fix: exact O(1) inverse chr(token_id - 1) for codepoints below the modulus

verification.test_strengthened: test_hash_tokenize_detokenize_roundtrip_chars asserted only len(back)==len(text) and could not detect a lossy tokenizer; it now asserts identity over multi-line inputs.

cpu_validation.purpose: check whether removing the truncation makes the task learnable on the current corpus
cpu_validation.config: d_model=192, n_layers=4, 300 steps, batch 8, real p1_distill_train_v1
cpu_validation.note: loss no longer collapses to ~0.007 because the model now has real content to fit rather than 96 memorised 64-char fragments
cpu_validation.interpretation: With the truncation removed the trained model abstains on all 150 atoms (coverage 0) and does not beat a random-init control. This is consistent with the data-scale finding: 4,516 characters of training text cannot teach the task regardless of context width. The tokenizer defect made the task impossible; data scale makes it unlearnable. Both must be fixed.
cpu_validation.caveat: This validation used a much smaller model (d_model 192 vs 704) for 300 CPU steps and is not a substitute for a proper GPU re-run; it is evidence about the corpus, not a tuned result.

invalidated: all exact_gold_span and support metrics from constrained eval
consequences.reason: every native result to date was produced by models that could see at most 64 characters of a ~530-character prompt, with corrupted turn separators
not_invalidated: the agent canary results (different code path)

next: Do not re-run native arms until the training corpus is addressed (data scale is still binding)
Any re-run must ship random-init + majority-class controls and free-generation eval
Re-derive mechanism ranking from scratch — prior rankings carry no information
